title: MidCap Financial Investment Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: MidCap Financial Investment Corporation (MFIC), a Business Development Company (BDC) listed on NASDAQ, filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026 disclosing that Howard Widra will resign as director and Executive Chairman effective at the close of business on June 18, 2026. Widra, who is retiring from Apollo Global Management Inc., will not stand for re-election at the 2026 annual stockholders meeting. The filing states the departure is not due to disagreement with the company.
key_points: Howard Widra resigning as director and Executive Chairman effective June 18, 2026
Resignation connected to Widra's retirement from Apollo Global Management Inc.
Widra will not stand for re-election at 2026 annual stockholders meeting
Filing explicitly states no disagreement with company, investment adviser, Board, or affiliates
Company is MidCap Financial Investment Corp (ticker: MFIC), a BDC managed by Apollo
Filed by Chief Legal Officer and Secretary Kristin M. Hester on April 20, 2026
